Name: Seasonal Elfflower Obelisks and Gold Clock for Alternative Textures and as stand-alone furniture
Author: LCKa
Description:
Small update: the furniture version is now updated to 1.1.0 to remove the obelisk furniture from random sales and to apply the location-based conditions of availability to those who choose to side with Morris and don't go the Community Center Route.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Updated to version 1.2.0.
With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28572]umganil[/url]'s permission, the obelisks and gold clock are now available as furniture, meaning you can buy as many as you want even if you use a different obelisk and gold clock recolor. The obelisk statues still have the same size, so this furniture is supposed to be placed outside. The gold clock, being the same size as the Winter Star Tree, can be placed either inside or outside.

They are available within the Wizard Furniture Catalogue, which can be bought at Krobus's store for a significant sum. So the furniture itself isn't very expensive, at 5000 for the obelisk statues and 10000 for the gold clock. The furniture is seasonal: every time the season changes, the furniture will automatically adopt a new appearance.

One last thing: to keep this somewhat lore-friendly, some of the obelisk statues only become available after you've reached some specific locations. The gold clock has no restrictions, because I was not going to make you wait until you've almost reached perfection.

As always, many thanks to umganil. The assets are all theirs, and any compliment about the art is theirs by right. Go visit the original mod and leave kudos, please!
The mods are compatible. You can download both versions, or only one, it's up to you.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This absolutely gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28572]mod[/url] deserved an AT version so the players who depend on Alternative Textures can use it. umganil very graciously gave me permission to upload this. In case of any technical issue, don't bother them, holler at me, please! But any kudos for the incredible art must of course go to its creator.

This mod requires Alternative Textures. To install, just unzip it into your Mods folder.
1.1.1: Added the UpdateKeys.

Thanks again, umganil!
